complexity.notes: best_buy is dead code — it is updated but never used in the profit computation, and its initializer 100 hard-codes the capped price range. The natural O(n) single-pass solution (track running minimum and best profit) would be both simpler and faster.
complexity.summary: Brute-force: for each buy day i, scans every later day j and keeps the maximum profit, returning 0 if none is profitable.
